items.zh: 你好，我是 Utopia，很高兴认识你。
items.en: Hi, I'm Utopia. Nice to meet you.
items.example: Hi, I'm Alex. Great to meet you.
Likewise.
I'm based in Shenzhen.

items.zh: 我在一家科技公司做产品。
items.en: I work in product at a tech company.
items.example: I'm a product manager at a tech company.

items.en: I've been doing this for a few years.
items.example: I've been in this field for a while now.
What do you do for work?
Where are you originally from?

items.zh: 我不是本地人，不过在深圳住了好几年了。
items.en: I'm not from here originally, but I've lived in Shenzhen for years.
items.example: I moved here a few years ago.

items.en: How long have you been here?
items.example: How long have you lived here?
How have you been?

items.en: Pretty good, just a bit busy.
items.example: Not bad, just busy with work.
Nothing much, same as usual.

items.en: What have you been up to lately?
items.example: What are you up to these days?
It's been a busy few weeks.

items.en: I've been working on my spoken English.
items.example: I'm trying to improve my English.

items.en: What do you like to do in your free time?
items.example: What do you do for fun?

items.en: I like to get out and explore on weekends.
items.example: On weekends I usually go for a walk.

items.zh: 我对 AI 挺感兴趣的。
items.example: I'm pretty interested in tech.
You look familiar.

items.zh: 抱歉，你刚才说你叫什么？
items.en: Sorry, what was your name again?
items.example: Sorry, I didn't catch your name.

items.en: How do you spell your name?
items.example: Could you spell that for me?
Let me introduce you to my coworker, Leo.
Can I get your number?
What about you?
Oh, that's cool!
No way!

items.zh: 我英语不太好，能说慢一点吗？
items.en: My English isn't perfect, so could you speak a little slower?
items.example: Could you say that again, please?
Got it.

items.en: It was great talking to you.
items.example: I really enjoyed chatting with you.
Catch you later!
